Header with Tabs
Overview Activity Settings

Inventory for 14 products is below the reorder level. The suggested purchase order covers four weeks of sales based on the last 90 days. Review the quantities before you send it to the supplier, because two items have seasonal demand.

Customer support closed 312 tickets this week. Most questions were about delivery dates and invoice copies. Adding the tracking link to the order email should cut these questions by about a third, according to last quarter's test.

The quarterly report is ready for review. It covers revenue, refunds, new customers and churn by region. Comments from the finance team are due on Friday, after which the report goes to the board.

Save
Header Tabs Buttons
Overview Activity Settings

Two-step sign-in is now required for owners and administrators. Members without a verification app get a code by email. Accounts that do not turn it on within 14 days lose access until they complete the setup.

The new pricing for annual plans starts on November 1. Existing customers keep their price until the next renewal. Send the announcement at least 30 days before the change, as the terms of service require.

This month the store processed 1,896 orders with an average value of $73. Conversion on mobile rose from 2.1% to 2.6% after the new checkout went live, while desktop stayed flat. The team plans to test one-click payments next.
